title: Behaviour shared by every /api/* route (http.ts, auth.ts, netlify.toml)

routing.rule: netlify.toml rewrites /api/* to /.netlify/functions/:splat with status 200, so /api/<name> reaches netlify/functions/<name>.ts. The rewrite is placed before the SPA catch-all.
exceptions: userinfo.ts declares `export const config = { path: '/api/userinfo' }` (userinfo.ts:32), so it is served on that path directly (Functions v2 custom path), not via the rewrite.
The 7 *-background functions are also reachable through the rewrite as /api/<name>-background (no auth). See api-background-functions.json.
routing.unknownApiPath: An /api/<x> with no matching function is not handled by any handler (Netlify returns its own 404 page, not a JSON {error}). Not covered by the code; record it as platform behaviour, not contract.

jsonHelper.fact: json(body, status=200) returns `new Response(JSON.stringify(body), {status, headers: {'content-type': 'application/json'}})`. Only content-type is set: no cache-control, no charset.

errorBody.fact: errorResponse(e): an HttpError becomes `{"error": e.message}` with e.status. Anything else (Supabase PostgrestError objects, TypeError, SyntaxError from req.json(), Blob errors, fetch errors) is logged and becomes 500 `{"error":"Internal error"}`.
errorBody.consequence: A malformed JSON body read with a bare `await req.json()` (no .catch) produces 500 {"error":"Internal error"}, not 400. Routes that wrap req.json() in .catch() behave differently; each route file says which it does.

bearerToken.fact: The Authorization header must match /^Bearer\s+(.+)$/i (scheme case-insensitive). Otherwise throws HttpError(401, 'Missing bearer token').

errors.when: header absent, empty, not 'Bearer <x>' (e.g. 'Basic ...', 'Bearer' with no token)

requireUser.fact: 1) bearerToken. 2) Dev bypass: when env DEV_SECRET_KEY is set and the token equals it, returns {userId: DEV_USER_ID, email: DEV_USER_EMAIL ?? null}; if DEV_USER_ID is unset throws 500. 3) Otherwise supabase adminClient().auth.getUser(token); an error or no user throws 401.

errors.when: token equals DEV_SECRET_KEY but DEV_USER_ID unset (an HttpError, so the message is passed through)
Supabase getUser returns an error or no user
getUser throws (network failure), or SUPABASE_URL / SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY missing (requireEnv throws a plain Error)

tests.asserts: valid token -> {userId,email}; no token -> HttpError; Supabase rejection -> HttpError (status not asserted)

requireAdmin.fact: requireUser, then profiles.is_admin must be truthy; else HttpError(403, 'Admin access required'). A DB error reading profiles throws a PostgrestError -> 500 Internal error.

auth.authBeforeMethod: Every handler that uses requireUser/requireAdmin calls it as the first statement inside try, before any method check or body parse, so a request with no token always gets 401 regardless of method or body. Exceptions are noted per route (userinfo has its own scheme).

methodHandling: There is no global method filter. Each handler either branches on req.method (and returns a route-specific 405 or falls through) or ignores the method entirely. Each route file says which.
headersNotSet: No handler sets CORS headers. The 'json' helper sets only content-type. Binary routes set their own content-type / cache-control (see each route).

jobBlobStores.fact: Async job records live in Netlify Blobs stores: storyline-jobs, brand-extract-jobs, quick-jobs, brand-pptx-jobs, brand-preview-jobs, deck-jobs (deck JobState). Each record carries userId; status routes compare it to the caller.

caps.fact: Env-tunable caps with defaults: DECKS_PER_USER_PER_DAY=2, MAX_SLIDES_PER_DECK=12, GLOBAL_IMAGES_PER_DAY=400, INTAKE_TURNS_PER_USER_PER_DAY=120, BRAND_EXTRACTS_PER_USER_PER_DAY=10. Non-numeric env values fall back to the default.

testBaseline.fact: Offline run of `npx vitest run netlify/functions` on 2026-10-08 (Node v24.15.0): 50 files, 391 tests, 6 failing in 4 files: _tests/status.test.ts (1, expects the pre-variant-removal {A,B} slide shape), _tests/image.test.ts (2), _tests/brand-preview.test.ts (file fails to load), _tests/brand-pptx-background.test.ts (3, 5s timeouts). Those tests are NOT a valid oracle until fixed; the handler code is. See the per-route files for details.
